The '''Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song''' is a [[Golden Globe Awards|Golden Globe Award]] that was awarded for the first time in 1962 and has been awarded annually from 1965 to 2023 by the [[Hollywood Foreign Press Association]]. The award is presented to the songwriters of a song written specifically for a motion picture.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |url=http://www.goldenglobes.com/winners-nominees/best-original-song-motion-picture |title=Winners & Nominees Best Original Song – Motion Picture at the Golden Globe Awards website |access-date=2017-08-07 |archive-date=2017-01-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170106035845/http://www.goldenglobes.com/winners-nominees/best-original-song-motion-picture |url-status=live }}</ref> The performers of the song are not credited, unless they also have a writing or co-writing credit.
